title: Handbook and config sample still teach the retired boundary test run
action: The tdt-1 judge found the retired doctrine surviving across the handbook after the source was fixed. Every hit asserts, in bare present tense, that tests prove at the boundary and that `bee close` / `bee worktree merge` run the declared command. Decisions 58ec9664 and 1f534837 retired that: each cap records its own proof line `<command> — <result> — <scope reason>`, both doors check that recorded proof and run nothing themselves, and CI runs the declared command on every push — the one deterministic net. Known hits to start from, but re-grep rather than trusting this list: docs/handbook/register.md:131, docs/handbook/architecture-map.md:96 and :150, docs/handbook/stages/planning.md:73, docs/handbook/stages/executing.md:37 and :47, docs/codebase-overview.md:90, and .bee/config-sample.json:6 (its commands.test help text). Rewrite each to the live rule, matching the surrounding voice and length — these are teaching surfaces, so state the rule, do not append a changelog note. JUDGMENT, and this is the whole craft of the cell: a line that frames itself as a dated snapshot, a locked historical record, or an X-refines-Y banner is CORRECT as written and must be left alone; only bare present-tense assertions of the retired behavior get rewritten. That distinction already decided two separate citation audits this session. Do NOT touch docs/specs/test-simple.md (it carries a deliberate dated annotation and is a read-only compatibility surface per decision 40272d61), docs/history/**, or .bee/cells/archive/** — those are records of what was believed at the time.
verify: rg -n 'tests prove at the boundary|runs commands.test|records \{tests' docs/handbook docs/codebase-overview.md .bee/config-sample.json

truths: No file under docs/handbook/, nor docs/codebase-overview.md, nor .bee/config-sample.json, asserts in present tense that any local door runs commands.test.
Each rewritten passage states the live rule: proof line per cap, doors check the record, CI runs the command on every push.
Dated snapshots, locked records, and X-refines-Y banners are left untouched — the cap names any line judged to be one of those and why.
The verify grep returns no present-tense boundary-run assertion in the swept set.

done_when: Every teaching surface in the swept set states the live proof-line rule; records and dated snapshots are untouched; the verify grep is clean.
notes: Docs only, no Rust. Disjoint from tdt-2, which fixes the generated registry payload. Runs in parallel with it.
